description: Guides note-taking as the engine of thinking and writing. Use when reading and ideas must be captured as connected permanent notes rather than left in an inert archive; when complex thinking needs to happen in writing, not in the head, so an argument can be examined at a distance; when a note-taking routine must be built strategically as a habit rather than willed into being; when a workflow must gather by relevance and actively seek disconfirming evidence instead of defending a favored hypothesis; or when a note collection is accumulating into an unconnected heap and needs deliberate cross-linking, a critical mass of well-handled notes, and changed day-to-day routines before it can pay off as a tool to think with.
